captions.LI:
Evening sessions at the Bariatric Counseling Center run Monday through Thursday, 5:30 to 8:30 p.m., both onsite and virtually. This track is designed for people who work during the day and need care that fits around their schedule. The program provides group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education in one integrated format. It is led by a clinical psychologist, licensed professional counselors, registered dietitians, movement therapists, and a registered nurse, as well as a professional chef. One program, not four. Patients typically attend for little to no cost. San Antonio and virtual across Texas. Learn more at bariatriccounselingcenter.com.

#BehavioralHealth
